questions.questionText: hour Additional Materials: Multiple Choice Answer Sheet Soft clean eraser Soft pencil (type B or HB is recommended) READ THESE INSTRUCTIONS FIRST Write in soft pencil. Do not use staples, paper clips, glue or correction fluid. Write your name, Centre number and candidate number on the Answer Sheet in the spaces provided unless this has been done for you. DO NOT WRITE IN ANY BARCODES. There are thirty questions on this paper. Answer all questions. For each question there are four possible answers A, B, C and D. Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the separate Answer Sheet. Read the instructions on the Answer Sheet very carefully. Each correct answer will score one mark. A mark will not be deducted for a wrong answer. Any rough working should be done in this booklet.

questions.questionText: In the diagram a consumer's budget line shifts from GH to JK. G J good Y O K H good X Which statement is correct?

questions.questionText: Night shift workers are often paid more than day shift workers performing the same tasks. What could explain this observed wage differential?

options.A: higher productivity of day shift workers
options.B: non-pecuniary disadvantages of working night shifts
options.C: the absence of competition between the two groups of workers
options.D: the inclusion of economic rent in the wages paid to night shift workers

questions.questionText: What acts as a constraint on the use of income taxes to redistribute income to poorer groups in society?

options.A: the costs to employers of tax collection
options.B: the fact that poorer groups have a higher marginal propensity to save
options.C: the fact that richer and poorer groups have the same marginal propensity to consume

questions.questionText: Between 2008 and 2009 a country’s national income at current prices increased by 15%. At the same time the country experienced 5% inflation. Which index number most closely represents the country’s national income in 2009 at 2008 prices (2008 = 100)?
Despite a government budget deficit, a country’s money supply remains unchanged. What could explain this?

options.A: The country has a balance of payments surplus equal to the government budget deficit.
options.B: The country’s foreign exchange rate is fixed.
options.C: The government budget deficit is financed by borrowing from the central bank.
options.D: The government budget deficit is financed by selling government bonds to members of the public.

options.B: a decent standard of living
options.C: a long and healthy life
options.D: equal economic opportunity

questions.questionText: What is the opportunity cost to society of an increase in unemployment?

options.A: the increase in taxes to pay for unemployment benefits
options.B: the loss in national output
options.C: the reduction in the disposable income of those who lose their jobs
options.D: the resulting increase in the government’s fiscal deficit

options.C: an increase in import tariffs
options.D: the introduction of import quotas
